adjudication.rationale: In `store.js` `_hydrateEmbedded`, the new plural branch matches any key ending in `_ids` via `/(.+)\_id(s?)$/` and, when plural, always assigns `obj[self.pluralize(subType)] = ...` and then `delete obj[k];` (the original `*_ids` key) without checking whether that field was intended as an association vs. a plain attribute. This is a real, diff-grounded behavioral change that could silently drop legitimate non-association `*_ids` attributes in any hydrated payload, but the diff doesn’t prove an existing payload is actually broken by it (the added tests/pretender use `color_ids` as an association).
